notes.title: Log: Major bug fixes and making cards!
notes.notes:
Ay-yo, commanders!

We've got all of your feedback, thank you to everyone who sent us bug reports after the release. We've been working on fixing the major ones, and finally managed to solve them!

Here's what's changed: 


 Boss stages are fixed for ultra wide monitors and two-monitor setups - you can actually destroy it now!
 Accuracy count is also fixed - 100% is a 100% and no more.


Some more fixes are in the works, but we still need as much feedback as possible - check out the discussions to find out how to send us a game log. Any help is very appreciated.

Now, for the bigger news - community items and trading cards have been approved!

Thank you again for the love and support you've given the game and the Eisenblum team, you made the items and cards possible! Now, the team has started making them, so we hope to share them with you soon.
